2	# scripts/benchmark/benchmark — operator-facing benchmark driver.
3	#
4	# Replaces `fiz-bench sweep` / `fiz-bench matrix` execution. Pure shell:
5	# yq + jq + sha256sum + docker. No Go bridge, no Python.
6	#
7	# Bead fizeau-fe87a3ac: skeleton + listing subcommands + --plan mode +
8	# preflight rebuild gate. The cell execution loop (resume, retry, signal
9	# handling, concurrency, budget) lands in a follow-up bead.
10	#
11	# Operator contract:
12	#   ./benchmark profiles
13	#   ./benchmark bench-sets
14	#   ./benchmark harness-adapters
15	#   ./benchmark task-executors
16	#   ./benchmark validate                            # placeholder; see PR C
17	#   ./benchmark preflight                           # rebuild harbor-runner if sha drifted
18	#   ./benchmark --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...] --plan
19	#   ./benchmark --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...]   # run path; PR A4
20	#
21	# Rules:
22	#   1. --plan is pure: no file writes, no Docker pulls/builds, no
23	#      benchmark-results/ creation. Prints one matrix line per cell.
24	#   2. --profile and --bench-set are both required for --plan and run.
25	#   3. preflight is the only command that touches Docker.
26	
27	set -euo pipefail
28	
29	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
30	PROFILES_DIR="${PROFILES_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/profiles}"
31	BENCH_SETS_DIR="${BENCH_SETS_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/bench-sets}"
32	HARNESS_ADAPTERS_DIR="${HARNESS_ADAPTERS_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/harness-adapters}"
33	TASK_EXECUTORS_DIR="${TASK_EXECUTORS_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/task-executors}"
34	HARBOR_BUILD_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/build-harbor-runner.sh"
35	HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG="${HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG:-fizeau-harbor-runner:latest}"
36	DEFAULT_OUT_ROOT="${DEFAULT_OUT_ROOT:-bench/results/fiz-tools-v1}"
37	BENCH_TASKS_DIR_DEFAULT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/external/terminal-bench-2"
38	BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-4}"
39	BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE:-1}"
40	FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR="${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/fizeau-benchmark}"
41	BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS="${BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS:-30}"
42	
43	export SCRIPT_DIR \
44	  PROFILES_DIR \
45	  BENCH_SETS_DIR \
46	  HARNESS_ADAPTERS_DIR \
47	  TASK_EXECUTORS_DIR \
48	  HARBOR_BUILD_SCRIPT \
49	  HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG \
50	  DEFAULT_OUT_ROOT \
51	  BENCH_TASKS_DIR_DEFAULT \
52	  BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS \
53	  BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE \

57	die() { printf 'benchmark: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
58	warn() { printf 'benchmark: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
59	
60	require_tool() {
61	  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "required tool not found: $1"
62	}
63	
64	# in_flight_state_dir returns the host-specific state directory.
65	in_flight_state_dir() {
66	  local hostname
67	  hostname="$(hostname)"
68	  printf '%s/%s\n' "${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}" "${hostname}"
69	}
70	
71	# in_flight_lock_path returns the lock path for a concurrency group.
72	in_flight_lock_path() {
73	  local group="$1"
74	  printf '%s/locks/%s.lock\n' "${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}" "${group}"
75	}
76	
77	# in_flight_json_path returns the path to the in-flight state JSON file.
78	in_flight_json_path() {
79	  printf '%s/in-flight.json\n' "$(in_flight_state_dir)"
80	}
81	
82	# acquire_group_lock acquires an flock for a concurrency group, blocking if needed.
83	# Returns 0 on success, prints the lock fd to stdout.
84	acquire_group_lock() {
85	  local group="$1"
86	  local lock_path
87	  lock_path="$(in_flight_lock_path "${group}")"
88	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "${lock_path}")"
89	  local lock_fd
90	  lock_fd=200
91	  eval "exec ${lock_fd}>'${lock_path}'"
92	  flock "${lock_fd}" || die "failed to acquire lock for concurrency-group=${group}"
93	  printf '%d\n' "${lock_fd}"
94	}
95	
96	# release_group_lock releases an flock acquired by acquire_group_lock.
97	release_group_lock() {
98	  local lock_fd="$1"
99	  eval "exec ${lock_fd}>&-" || true
100	}

102	# export_cell_worker_functions exports the shell functions that the
103	# per-cell setsid worker needs after bash -c hands execution off to a
104	# fresh session leader.
105	export_cell_worker_functions() {

152	# register_inflight registers a cell as in-flight in the state file.
153	# Reads current entries, adds this cell, removes dead PIDs, writes back.
154	register_inflight() {
155	  local cell_id="$1" cell_dir="$2"
156	  local state_dir
157	  state_dir="$(in_flight_state_dir)"
158	  mkdir -p "${state_dir}"
159	  local json_path
160	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
161	
162	  local current_json="{\"cells\":[]}"
163	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] && current_json="$(cat "${json_path}")" || true
164	
165	  # Prune dead PIDs by filtering in bash
166	  local live_cells=()
167	  local cell_json pid
168	  while IFS= read -r cell_json; do
169	    [[ -z "${cell_json}" ]] && continue
170	    pid="$(jq -r '.pid' <<<"${cell_json}")"
171	    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
172	      live_cells+=("${cell_json}")
173	    fi
174	  done < <(jq -r '.cells[] | @json' <<<"${current_json}")
175	
176	  # Rebuild with live cells
177	  current_json="$(printf '%s\n' "${live_cells[@]}" | jq -s '{cells:.}')"
178	
179	  # Add this cell
180	  current_json="$(jq \
181	    --arg cell_id "${cell_id}" \
182	    --arg cell_dir "${cell_dir}" \
183	    --argjson pid "${BASHPID}" \
184	    '.cells += [{cell_id:$cell_id, cell_dir:$cell_dir, pid:$pid}]' \
185	    <<<"${current_json}")"
186	
187	  printf '%s\n' "${current_json}" >"${json_path}.tmp"
188	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"
189	}

195	  local json_path

199	  local updated
200	  updated="$(jq \
201	    --arg cell_id "${cell_id}" \
202	    '.cells |= map(select(.cell_id != $cell_id))' \

209	# interrupt_inflight_cells is called during signal handling. For each in-flight cell:
210	#   1. SIGTERM the cell's process group
211	#   2. docker stop containers matching the cell's label (--time=30s grace)
212	#   3. Wait up to grace_seconds for containers to stop
213	#   4. Force-kill any stragglers with docker kill
214	# Also removes the cell from in-flight.json.
215	interrupt_inflight_cells() {
216	  local grace_seconds="${BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS:-30}"
217	  local json_path
218	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
219	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] || return 0
220	
221	  local cells
222	  cells="$(jq -r '.cells[] | @json' "${json_path}")" || return 0
223	
224	  local cell_id cell_dir pid
225	  local cell_count=0
226	  local cells_to_kill=()
227	
228	  while IFS= read -r cell_json; do
229	    [[ -z "${cell_json}" ]] && continue
230	    cell_id="$(jq -r '.cell_id' <<<"${cell_json}")"
231	    cell_dir="$(jq -r '.cell_dir' <<<"${cell_json}")"
232	    pid="$(jq -r '.pid' <<<"${cell_json}")"
233	
234	    [[ -n "${cell_id}" ]] || continue
235	    cells_to_kill+=("${cell_id}:${pid}")
236	    cell_count=$((cell_count + 1))
237	
238	    # SIGTERM the cell's process group (try both negative PID for process group and regular PID)
239	    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && (( pid > 0 )); then
240	      kill -TERM -"${pid}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "${pid}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
241	    fi
242	  done <<<"${cells}"
243	
244	  # If there are containers to stop, do so with a grace period
245	  if [[ ${cell_count} -gt 0 ]]; then
246	    for cell_spec in "${cells_to_kill[@]}"; do
247	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*}"
248	      docker ps -q --filter "label=fizeau-cell=${cell_id}" 2>/dev/null \
249	        | xargs -r docker stop --time=30 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
250	    done
251	
252	    # Wait a bit for containers to actually stop
253	    sleep 2
254	
255	    # Force-kill any remaining containers that didn't stop
256	    for cell_spec in "${cells_to_kill[@]}"; do
257	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*}"
258	      docker ps -q --filter "label=fizeau-cell=${cell_id}" 2>/dev/null \
259	        | xargs -r docker kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
260	    done
261	  fi
262	
263	  # Clear in-flight entries (they should have trap handlers that do this too, but be explicit)
264	  : >"${json_path}.tmp"
265	  printf '{"cells":[]}\n' >"${json_path}.tmp"
266	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"
267	}

389	# resolve_tasks emits one task id per line for a bench-set.
390	# Handles three shapes:
391	#   tasks: [id, id, ...]         inline list
392	#   tasks: all                   defer to harness dataset; emit "*all*"
393	#   tasks_from: <path>           load tasks[].id from a sibling YAML
394	# tasks_from and inline tasks merge in deterministic order with duplicates
395	# removed on first occurrence.
396	resolve_tasks() {
397	  local bs_file="$1"
398	  local bs_json tasks_kind tasks_from
399	  bs_json="$(bench_set_json "${bs_file}")"
400	
401	  tasks_kind="$(jq -r '
402	    if (.tasks // null) == null then "none"
403	    elif (.tasks | type) == "array" then "list"
404	    elif (.tasks | type) == "string" then ("string:" + .tasks)
405	    else "other"
406	    end' <<<"${bs_json}")"
407	
408	  tasks_from="$(jq -r '.tasks_from // ""' <<<"${bs_json}")"
409	
410	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "string:all" ]]; then
411	    [[ -z "${tasks_from}" ]] || die "bench-set ${bs_file}: tasks: all cannot be combined with tasks_from"
412	    # Defer to the harness dataset. The plan path emits a sentinel so
413	    # operators see the contract; the run path (PR A4) expands at execution.
414	    printf '*all*\n'
415	    return 0
416	  fi
417	
418	  local -A seen_tasks=()
419	  local emitted=0
420	  local task resolved
421	
422	  emit_task() {
423	    local task="$1"
424	    [[ -n "${task}" ]] || return 0
425	    if [[ -z "${seen_tasks["${task}"]+x}" ]]; then
426	      seen_tasks["${task}"]=1
427	      printf '%s\n' "${task}"
428	      emitted=1
429	    fi
430	  }
431	
432	  if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" ]]; then
433	    resolved="$(cd "$(dirname "${bs_file}")" && cd "$(dirname "${tasks_from}")" && pwd)/$(basename "${tasks_from}")"
434	    [[ -f "${resolved}" ]] || die "tasks_from path not found: ${tasks_from} (resolved to ${resolved})"
435	    while IFS= read -r task; do
436	      emit_task "${task}"
437	    done < <(
438	      yq -o=json '.' "${resolved}" \
439	        | jq -r '
440	            .tasks[]?
441	            | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
442	          '
443	    )
444	  fi
445	
446	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
447	    while IFS= read -r task; do
448	      emit_task "${task}"
449	    done < <(jq -r '
450	      .tasks[] | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
451	    ' <<<"${bs_json}")
452	  elif [[ "${tasks_kind}" != "none" ]]; then
453	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: unsupported tasks shape"
454	  fi
455	
456	  if [[ ${emitted} -eq 0 ]]; then
457	    if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" || "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
458	      die "bench-set ${bs_file}: resolved no tasks"
459	    fi
460	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: no .tasks list, .tasks: all, or .tasks_from set"
461	  fi
462	}

780	      | LC_ALL=C sort \

997	# Invoke the task-executor with bounded exponential backoff on transient
998	# errors. Returns 0 on success; non-zero on terminal failure after retries.
999	# Captures attempts log to ${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt for forensics.
1000	run_executor_with_retry() {
1001	  local task_spec="$1" cell_dir="$2" executor="$3"
1002	  local stderr_file
1003	  stderr_file="$(mktemp)"
1004	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1005	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1006	  local attempt=1
1007	  local status=0
1008	  local retry_log="${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt"
1009	  : >"${retry_log}"
1010	  while :; do
1011	    : >"${stderr_file}"
1012	    set +e
1013	    printf '%s' "${task_spec}" | "${executor}" 2>"${stderr_file}" >/dev/null
1014	    status=$?
1015	    set -e
1016	    printf 'attempt=%d status=%d\n' "${attempt}" "${status}" >>"${retry_log}"
1017	    if [[ ${status} -eq 0 ]]; then
1018	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1019	      return 0
1020	    fi
1021	    cat "${stderr_file}" >>"${retry_log}"
1022	    if (( attempt > max_attempts )) || ! is_transient_stderr "${stderr_file}"; then
1023	      cat "${stderr_file}" >&2
1024	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1025	      return "${status}"
1026	    fi
1027	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}); sleeping ${backoff}s"
1028	    sleep "${backoff}"
1029	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1030	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1031	  done
1032	}

1090	# compute_cell_cost prints the cost_usd_at_run_time for a single cell. Uses
1091	# profile.pricing × token streams pulled from the cell's result.json. Token
1092	# field names follow the canonical report-level naming
1093	# (input_tokens / output_tokens / cached_input_tokens) and are also probed
1094	# under the harbor totals naming (total_prompt_tokens / total_completion_tokens
1095	# / total_cached_input_tokens) so harness-native token reporters land in the
1096	# same accumulator.
1097	#
1098	# When profile.pricing is all zero (or unset) and the executor wrote an
1099	# explicit cost_usd / total_cost_usd in result.json, the explicit value is
1100	# honored — that lets harnesses that observe API-reported cost directly
1101	# participate in budget enforcement.
1102	compute_cell_cost() {
1103	  local result_json="${1:-}" profile_json="${2:-}"
1104	  [[ -n "${result_json}" ]] || result_json='{}'
1105	  [[ -n "${profile_json}" ]] || profile_json='{}'
1106	  jq -nr \
1107	    --argjson result "${result_json}" \
1108	    --argjson profile "${profile_json}" \
1109	    '
1110	      def num(v): if (v == null) then 0 else (v | tonumber? // 0) end;
1111	      ($profile.pricing // {}) as $p
1112	      | num($p.input_usd_per_mtok)         as $pi
1113	      | num($p.output_usd_per_mtok)        as $po
1114	      | num($p.cached_input_usd_per_mtok)  as $pc
1115	      | num($result.input_tokens
1116	            // $result.total_prompt_tokens
1117	            // $result.n_input_tokens
1118	            // 0)                          as $ti
1119	      | num($result.output_tokens
1120	            // $result.total_completion_tokens
1121	            // $result.n_output_tokens
1122	            // 0)                          as $to
1123	      | num($result.cached_input_tokens
1124	            // $result.total_cached_input_tokens
1125	            // $result.n_cached_input_tokens
1126	            // 0)                          as $tc
1127	      | num($result.cost_usd // $result.total_cost_usd // 0) as $reported
1128	      | (($ti * $pi) + ($to * $po) + ($tc * $pc)) / 1000000  as $priced
1129	      | (if $priced > 0 then $priced
1130	         elif ($pi + $po + $pc) == 0 then $reported
1131	         else 0
1132	         end)
1133	      | tostring
1134	    '
1135	}

1488	    local cell_dir
1489	    cell_dir="$(run_one_cell "${out}" "${profile_id}" "${profile_file}" \
1490	                  "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1491	                  "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${adapter}" "${prior_cell_dir}" \

# run.sh — master test runner for benchmark tests
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
TESTS_PASSED=0
TESTS_FAILED=0

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

run_test() {
  local test_file="$1"
  local test_name="$(basename "$test_file")"

  echo -e "${YELLOW}Running $test_name...${NC}"

  if bash "$test_file" 2>&1; then
    TESTS_PASSED=$((TESTS_PASSED + 1))
  else
    TESTS_FAILED=$((TESTS_FAILED + 1))
  fi

  echo ""
}

main() {
  echo "Running all benchmark test suites..."
